BiblicalUsage: Achish is the Philistine king of Gath who shelters David twice.
TheologicalSignificance: Achish is a reminder that God's people sometimes find shelter in strange places. David's madness act is not his finest hour, but God used even a Philistine king's court to keep him alive — and I hold that the same God keeps His people in places they would never have chosen.
RelatedPeople: King David; Achish, Son of Maoch
RelatedEvents: David Among the Philistines; David Recovers Ziklag
